goal: Find why gemini_queue.run_job started live-aid-news-panel (gemini-queue commit f8c5e4895, 15:43 IST) about 1h50 after a session built it (e74038d3d, 13:51) and 70 min after the card was closed (2db125d50, 14:31); then close the gap: run_job refuses a card that is not state ready on origin/fast-track or whose state tag is SHIPPED/STALE.

note: REVIEWED:2026-10-30 ACCEPT | DECISION (OURS): scope limited to the gemini_queue guard (existing runner, no new machinery under the S0 freeze); the session-side unclaimed build is reported in FINDING.md, not fixed here. The raw title says '20 min earlier'; git dates above are the truth.

steps: Timeline from git: git log --format='%h %an %ad' on MyTradingSys/system/tasks/live-aid-news-panel.json and on live_aid.html; the card state when gemini-queue claimed (read its log or the claims branch); note whether the session ever filed a claim.

Read gemini_queue.run_job (lines 97-135) and tasks.stop_tag/exclusion (tasks.py ~820, ~1470): run_job checks open claims only, never the card state or tag. Write FINDING.md: cause, 6 lines max, with sha for each fact.

Fix in gemini_queue.run_job only: after the fetch, read the card from origin/fast-track; skip with a log line 'SKIP <card>: state <x>/<tag>' unless state is ready and the tag is READY. Keep the existing claim skip.
Tests in test_gemini_queue.py: a done card, a SHIPPED-tag card and an unreadable card each skip (no worktree add, no agy call); a ready card still runs. Fail-first on the pre-change run_job.
tests: scripts/dev/test_gemini_queue.py: test_done_card_skipped, test_shipped_tag_skipped, test_unreadable_card_fails_closed (each fails on current run_job: it calls worktree add), test_ready_card_runs
title: Two workers built the same READY card: live-aid-news-panel was built in a session worktree and again by gemini-queue (f8c5e4895, 20 min earlier); the planner promoted the raw card to ready while the session held it unclaimed. Find why claim/ready did not block the second pickup
